concepts.name: Funeral lantern
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a SINGLE original Halloween octopus-replacement character concept for a pixel-art aquarium game. Attached reference is STYLE ONLY: match its meticulously detailed square-pixel clusters, crisp dark contours, rich restrained shading, gothic mood and muted deep-teal backdrop. Do not copy any of its four creatures or its four-panel layout.
Exactly ONE complete creature, ONE pose, centered, generally facing LEFT in a three-quarter side view, floating/hovering with all appendages fully visible and curled gracefully. Main compact head/mantle sits upper-left of the silhouette and arms spread below and trail right. Generous margin. Simple uniform dark desaturated teal background. No scenery, bubbles, extra characters, loose props or frame. Square composition. Fine deliberate pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT smooth 3D, no blur or bloom. Design: An antique blackened iron funeral lantern forms the mantle, holding a tiny pale blue spectral flame behind gothic window bars. Eight long flexible wrought-iron scrollwork arms mixed with torn charcoal funeral ribbons curl underneath and stream right. Strong compact lantern silhouette, restrained cyan light, tarnished silver accents.
One small legible ivory caption centered underneath the creature, exactly: "5 — Funeral lantern". No other text.
